name: Blue Action Fund calls for proposals
summary: Large multi-year grants to NGOs and NGO consortia for marine protected areas, other area-based conservation and coastal livelihoods in ODA-eligible countries, awarded through themed regional calls.

geography.label: Marine waters of countries eligible to receive official development assistance (ODA)

reporting: Semi-annual progress reports with a technical and a financial part, an annual logframe and safeguards update, and a final technical and financial report at the end of the project.

calls.label: 2026 call: Mangroves, Blue Carbon Markets, and 30x30 in Asia

status.quote: 2026 Mangroves, Blue Carbon Markets, and 30x30 in Asia More info Asia 17 million Closed 16 Oct 2026

deadline.quote: Call for Proposals Mangroves, Blue Carbon Markets, and 30x30 in Asia Closes 16 October 2026

applicant_types.quote: Blue Action Fund operates through a programme of providing grants to NGOs that typically work in partnerships with various local actors.

geography.quote: are located in the marine waters (territorial waters and/or exclusive economic zones) of one country eligible to receive official development assistance (ODA)

access.quote: We award our grants based on open calls for proposals only (see below).

window.quote: Its grant-awarding process is based on calls for proposals only.

amount.quote: require a Blue Action contribution that is within the range specified in the Call for Proposals, generally between EUR 2 - 4 million, in exceptional and well justified cases up to EUR 5 million

co_finance_required.quote: are able to fund at least 25% of the total project costs ('match funding').

reporting.quote: On a semi-annual basis, the grantee has to provide a progress report consisting of a technical and a financial part.
